test_pybind11_methods_and_attributes: test pybind11 bound methods and attributes including overloaded functions and property access on C++ classes
test_pybind11_properties: test pybind11 readonly, readwrite, and writeonly properties on both instance and static class attributes
test_pybind11_dynamic_attributes: test pybind11 dynamic attribute assignment and __dict__ access on C++ extension classes
test_pybind11_cyclic_gc: test pybind11 garbage collection handling for cyclic references between C++ extension class instances
test_pybind11_noconvert_args: test pybind11 argument conversion policies including no-convert and type-specific casting behavior
